event_id.description: Linked public Events page record for this activation, when one is published.

summit_id.description: The SotaSummit this activation takes place on.

summit_ref.description: Snapshot of the SOTA summit reference.

summit_points.description: Snapshot of the summit's activation points.

summit_location.description: Snapshot of the summit region / state.

scheduled_date.description: When the activation is scheduled to begin.

band.description: HAM band identifier when radio_service is HAM.

activation_log.description: JSON array of operational events recorded during the activation, including frequency and mode changes.

tx_mode.description: Operating mode: CW, SSB, FM, AM, DATA (FT8 etc.).

club_id.description: Associated club for club activations (blank = personal activation).

club_owner_id.description: User id of the club owner. Stamped for RLS so the club owner can view club activations.

operator_name.description: Display name of the activation creator.

co_host_ids.description: User ids of additional operators / co-hosts participating in the activation.

is_public.description: Public activations are visible to all users. Private activations are only visible to the operator and co-hosts.

contacts_count.description: Total contacts logged during this activation.

roster_members.description: JSON array of expected operators (callsign, name, location) planned for this activation.
